This work proposes the separation and enhanced classification of fetal ECG signals from abdominal ECG signals to find heart diseases of the fetal. In this paper MULTI-COMBI based blind source separation technique is used to separate the fetal ECG signals. The separated ECG signals have different features, which are extracted using the morphological feature extraction method. These extracted features are used for classification by Enhanced Navie Bayes Classification technique. This classifier classified into five different classes of disease. The entire work is implemented in MATLAB. The Simulated results of BSS method gives low PSNR and SIR values and the enhanced classifier gives the accuracy as 96.56%, Sensitivity as 89.56%, and Specificity as 97.54%.

articleTitle: Development and Implementation of Efficient Water and Energy Management System for Indian Villages
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: As India has been facing the consequences of drought, the development of efficient water and energy management revival schemes are inevitable for maintaining sustainability. Most is of our village infrastructure of our associated with over tanks and bathtub based on the population of village/street. Turn ON of public water tank pumps without considering tariff and time period (Peak and low peak), Turn OFF the pumps once the water overflows from the tank and Overconsumption of water for public water tubs are the hectic issues. Due to these issues, the excess amount of water is being wasted and a considerable amount of pressure is kept on the load dispatching center by adding load during the peak time period. In this paper, the embedded controller based revival scheme is proposed to suppress the wastage of water and improper energy utilization on a common interest. The real-time clock, GPRS module, and various sensors are interfaced with a controller to communicate with the pump and the operating personnel.

articleTitle: Distinguishing SARIMA with Extensive Neural Network Model for Forecasting Sugarcane Productivity
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: This work focuses on forecasting the yearly yield of sugarcane by incorporating rainfall statistics in order to enhance the cane production. Due to the oscillation of climate and lacking rainfall, the yield of crop productivity decreases unexpectedly. Hence, it requires modeling and simulation for predicting appropriate yield. Seasonal autoregressive integrated moving average along with the neural network model namely recurrent neural networks are implemented in this paper to analyze the yield depending on the amount of annual rainfall in turn to predict the future occurrences. According to the measures of mean absolute error, and root mean square error, the performance of the models is evaluated. It is proved that RNN got the lowest RMSE and MAE as compared to the SARIMA model.

articleTitle: Genetic Programming Modeling for Pollutant Removal from Aerobic Bioreactor Treating Industrial Wastewater
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Smart systems can be appropriately coordinated in industries to monitor and control the performance of wastewater treatment plants to regulate their pollutant discharge levels. Laboratory scale aerobic bioreactor was used in continuous treatment of toxic pollutants such as phenol, o-cresol, m-xylenol, quinoline, indole and cyanide representing wastewater from coal processing and steel manufacturing industries. This study models the treatment behavior of aerobic bioreactor in degradation of phenol and cyanide in presence of other toxic pollutants using Genetic Programming (GP). The root mean squares of error (RMSE) of GP run models from aerobic reactor treating cyanide was found to be 1.89; whereas those for phenol removal was 2.84. It was also found that hydraulic retention time played an important factor in increasing the efficiency of the treatment system. The GP based models highlights the detrimental effect of cyanide on microbial population while the positive influence of quinoline in removal of phenol from the bioreactor was brought upon from the model equation. The GP results were compared with those of Artificial Neural Networks (ANN). The outcomes show that GP is a more encouraging tool especially when modeling the treatment behavior of biological systems for toxic pollutants.

articleTitle: Power Quality Event Classification Using Transfer Learning on Images
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Given the ever-increasing complexity of the electrical grid system, power quality events have been surging in frequency with each passing day. Due to their potential to cause massive losses for a wide variety of customers, it is crucial that such events are detected and classified immediately for appropriate response. In this paper, a novel approach has been developed wherein Transfer Learning techniques have been employed to classify power quality events using image classification. More specifically, the VGG16 model has been utilized to classify five distinct power quality issues by using scalograms as input images. 489 scalograms were generated via feature extraction using wavelet transforms. The VGG16 model has then been trained and tested using the same. Thereafter, the model performance has been evaluated, and the results have been discussed.

articleTitle: A Novel One Stage Buck-Boost Inverter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: This paper proposes a Novel One Stage Buck Boost DC-AC Inverter (OSBBDAI) which boosts and inverts the input DC into AC. Generally for an application, where an AC output is generated from low voltage DC, two stage converters are used - a front end DC-DC boost converter followed by a DC-AC Inverter. But in proposed topology the conversion is possible in one stage which makes the system more compact, less weight and size. The Topology uses modified sine PWM in which the duty cycle is varied at each switching cycle ensuring a sine wave at output. This proposed system use equal number of switch in each half cycle which makes the AC output symmetrical. Steady state analysis of proposed OSBBDAI in discontinuous conduction mode is carried out in this paper. The simulation of the proposed converter is done using Matlab/Simulink validates the operation and analysis of the converter.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of Power Quality Improvement Strategy for MLI
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: The paper develops a pulse width modulation (PWM) approach for lowering the total harmonic distortion (THD) and increasing the fundamental component of the output voltage of single phase multilevel inverter (MLI). The significance of the use of MLI orients to synthesize the output with a better power quality. The number of level increase its serves to extract a nearly sinusoidal output voltage of the chosen amplitude. The MLI comprises of a H- bridge MLI inverter, eight power switches and four capacitor voltage dividers. The control signals that evolve from comparing the individual sinusoidal references with the triangular carrier enable controlling the switches. The schemes involve experimentally evaluating the performance using an appropriate prototype over a range of operating loads.

articleTitle: Assisted Border Intrusion & Detection System Using Dot Matrix Communication as Guiding Mechanism for Fishermen
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: With numerous borders placed at various geographical locations, territorial boundaries are present to claim sovereignty and the resources present inside them. While territorial boundaries are physically present on lands, there still exists a virtual boundary system at sea. This paper proposes a system to define the maritime borders virtually using computer indication systems for marine vessels and fisherman's boats which utilize GPS modules, sensing elements and communication topologies to establish multilateral communication between land and the marine vessel. The final system is discussed in two modules namely: Border Intrusion detection System and Dot Matrix Communication System. In order to find a permanent solution to the long existing problem, it is imperative to define clear boundaries either visually or by computerized systems in the ocean Furthermore; An effective communication strategy is implemented for faster data reception at the control center and feasible indications to the fishermen.

articleTitle: Smart and Secure Group Communication in Iot Using Exponential Based Self Healing Group Key Distribution Protocol
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: The major role of Internet of Things is to gather and exchange large amount of data through wireless network. Unreliable wireless network creates insecure connections, so security is very much important in IoT. Self-healing group key distribution protocol can be used to mitigate security issues for unreliable wireless network. It improves communication efficiency. we can recover lost session keys using broadcast message by group members in place of group manager requiring missing key update messages to be transmitted. This study also illustrates about a new E-SGKD protocol that faces many secure problems and uses AES algorithm provides security properties with appropriate storage requirement. We have compromised session key retrieve time to reduce expenses for communication. Output of this paper and simulation is appeal to Zigbee network as it has drastic outcome in communication and storage, the results will be compared with the access polynomial self-healing protocol for analysis process.

articleTitle: New Insights on Finger Knuckle Print Identification with Steerable Filter for Faster and Accurate Matching
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Finger-Knuckle-Print Identification is reasoned to be most trustworthy physiological biometric approach. Nowadays this emerging Finger Knuckle Print authentication based biometric system has been successfully applied in real time applications like Age-estimation in voter registration, Gender estimation etc,. This unique Finger Knuckle Print authentication procedure deals in finds its query image that matches with its own template that is stored in the database for verification. This work deals with the paradigms of visual analysis based on edge features for identifying the occlusion, Transparency and surface bends of images Therefore Linear filters combines with basis filter so called “steerable filter” helps in edge detection as main task that are utilized for image analysis and computation. Further this work deals with Consistency orientation Pattern (COP) which is implemented to execute fast search and precise result. Using this features extracted from steerable filters, this COP introduces a new idea to construct using consistent features for finding the genuine acceptance rate. This orientation tuning property of steerable filter makes this work easier to obtain more accurate result.

articleTitle: Power Quality Analysis of Single-Phase Transformer-less Buck-Boost Inverter for Compressor load
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Renewable energy sources are clean and have much lower environmental impact compared to that of conventional energy sources. Among various renewable sources solar is most important. But solar systems are too expensive and have lower efficiency. Conventional solar inverter includes a low frequency transformer which provides galvanic isolation between solar panel the grid. This decreases the efficiency of the solar panel and increases the size and cost of the solar panel and increases the size and cost of the system. Removal of low frequency transformer from the PV system increases the efficiency and decreases cost and size of the system. However the elimination of the transformer generates leakage current and is an important parameter for transformer less inverter. For a transformer less inverter the main objective is to minimize the leakage current, it is achieved in a transformer less buck-boost inverter. The converter in cooperates the buck, boost and buck-boost converter in one converter. This paper discussed power quality issues such as harmonics voltage variation are introduced when the inverter is connected to non linear loads. The simulation of a transformer less inverter fed load is done on the MATLAB Simulink.

articleTitle: Short Term Hydrothermal Scheduling Using Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: An optimal solution to the problem of hydrothermal scheduling, using Reinforcement Learning, is presented in this paper. The objective is to minimize the cost of the thermal unit, by making use of the available hydropower, subjected to various equality and inequality constraints. The cost function with and without valve loading effect have been considered. MATLAB software was used to schedule a base system comprising a single hydrothermal unit. The Reinforcement Learning algorithm employed uses the Q learning technique for obtaining the optimal policy. The Epsilon greedy algorithm has been used to select the actions during the learning phase. The results obtained for the simple hydrothermal system for both cost functions have been presented. The optimal schedule obtained incurs a cost that is much below that obtained in literature.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control of Quadruple Tank System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: In this paper, a Model Predictive Control (MPC) method is considered to reduce the on-stream computational complications of the nonlinear interconnected systems. Dynamic Matrix Control (DMC) algorithm which is the earlier platform of MPC is proposed to reduce the online complications. To access the performance of MPC, various process models first order and second order systems are analysed as an example and then the Two Input Two Output (TITO) system is simulated in MATLAB. The result of TITO system is interpreted with the example models.

articleTitle: Password Cracking Algorithm using Probabilistic Conjunctive Grammar
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: In this paper a password cracking algorithm is designed using Probabilistic Conjunctive Grammar (PCG). Here PCG is used for deriving the base structure of target password by combining multiple parse trees. After analysing the base structure of each password in the data-set, the base structures which are similar to the base structure of the targeted passwords are collected. In the final step, the password is cracked with its cracking probability.

articleTitle: Hardware Architecture for Acquisition in IRNSS Receiver using Serial Search Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Indian Regional Navigation Satellite System (IRNSS) is an independent, indigenously developed satellite navigation system by India. The ASIC design of the digital baseband receiver is the major requirement of any IRNSS handheld device for navigation. This work focuses on design and implementation of IRNSS signal acquisition in time domain. The major challenge in the time domain approach is the increase in acquisition time. By taking advantage of the straight forward implementation with less resource the serial search acquisition is designed by parallelizing frequency search for all carrier frequency bins considering maximum Doppler shift in the range of +/-10KHz with 500Hz resolution and code phase using serial search for half chip resolution. The numerically controlled oscillators are designed using quarter sine wave look-up table supporting a minimum resolution of 0.015Hz. The decision for the presence of the signal is done on the run without storing the intermediate results thereby reducing the memory requirement. The code is implemented in RTL (Register Transfer Level) using VHDL without using any third party IP core. The prototype is validated by implementing in Xilinx XC7Z045FFG900-2 FPGA. The acquisition time obtained is 1.023s for one satellite and the resources utilized is less (as given in Table-1).

articleTitle: Detection of Infectious Disease using Non-Invasive Logistic Regression Technique
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: The detection of infectious disease like Malaria among humans has been a challenging task for a long time. Although it is not life-threatening, if timely care is not provided to the individual, it may lead to serious health consequences. It has been realized that certain individualistic parameters like blood sugar, heart rate and body temperature are indicators of occurrence of malaria in a person. The objective of the work is to develop a logistic regression model for prediction of malaria incidence in a person based on the individual parameters. These individualistic parameters are measured non-invasively and fed to the developed logistic regression model. The proposed method detects infectious diseases in a given individual with maximum accuracy, speed and is highly reliable and robust in disease detection.

Author Keywords: blood glucose level and Logistic Regression

articleTitle: Analysis of wind energy development scheme in the energy-only market
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Day by day the share of a renewable energy producer in the electricity market is increasing. High penetration of renewable energy in the market leads us to merit order effect. To mitigate this effect we have to decide which type of development path is better to integrate renewable energy in the electrical system. In this paper, we present the two distinct wind energy development path in price capped energy-only market. For finding out suitable development path for wind power development, we develop the long-term simulation model for a 30-year period with 1-hour resolution. To compare both the development paths for wind power, we indicate important parameters such as security margin, average electricity price, development path for each technology.

articleTitle: Analysis of Sub Synchronous Resonance
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: This paper effort on analysis of Sub Synchronous resonance (SSR). SSR can be effectively analyzed by Eigenvalue analysis. Eigenvalue analysis is done by taking the linearized model of the system. The mechanical turbine-generator which is integrated with an electrical system is modelled, based on IEEE First Benchmark Model (FBM). The different values of Eigenvalues give different level of compensation for the electrical system and it is calculated and compared with the torsional mode appearances in the mechanical system. The frequencies of oscillation and the damping of each frequency are observed from the given Eigenvalues.

articleTitle: Design of Parallel Pipelined Architecture For Wavelet Based Image Compression Using Daubechie’s
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: In this project, we have a tendency to be visiting exhibit VLSI design for 2D Daubechies wavelet primarily based compression. The Daubechies wavelet transform provides mean values that compress the image so it takes up a lot of less space for storing, and thus transmits quicker electronically and in progressive levels of detail. Element worth are protected by the scaling issue from prodigious their limits. To implement the system numerous levels of scaling factors given and spitted into two level. These values enforced for numerous levels of 2D-DWT. We have a tendency to store the worthiest in buffer technique and simulate the output of VLSI system. The parallel-pipelined design obtained by RTL schematic. This buffer memory design employed for input, output memory storage. This buffer memory design is employed for input output memory storage. Compared to different typical technique the performance of this design is extremely economical in compression ratio, PSNR (Peak Signal to Noise Ratio), MSE (Mean sq. Error) and Time. This design is extremely economical to handle any image size. The proposed design has high compression quality as well as high speed and area-efficiency. Thisd esign is applicable for high-speed image compression and memory storage applications.

articleTitle: Application of Flower Pollination Algorithm for Solving Short Term Hydro Thermal Scheduling Problem with Prohibited Operating Zones
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Scheduling hydro and thermal power plants in short duration is a complex optimization problem in power generation system. The main function of this scheduling approach is in nonlinear nature and aims to optimize the thermal plant's running cost by considering numerous constraints taken in power plants. In this work, an effective stochastic method called Flower pollination algorithm (FPA) is implemented to arrive at the perfect solution. This algorithm has the evolutionary characteristics of pollinating process of flowers such that fittest members will survive and the subsequent generation of the healthier flowering plants. FPA executes the levy flight transport to generate members in the successive generation. To evaluate the efficacy of this algorithm, it is put forth to a standard test case by considering hydro and thermal power plant with a time slot of twelve hours interval on three days and simulated using the MATLAB software. Prohibited operating zones are included as additional constraints. The simulation results reveal that this meta-heuristic algorithm yields best outcome in minimum executing time than the other heuristic methods.

articleTitle: Enhanced Performance of Thermoelectric Generator by Modified H-Bridge Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Thermo electric generator (TEG) converts the temperature difference into voltage by See beck effect. Thermal gradient is the heart of thermo electric generator. High electrical conductivity and low thermal conductivity materials must have good thermo electric property. Now development of Nano technology can improve property of thermo electric materials with change in thermal conductivity without affecting electrical property. Thermo electric generator is a dynamic technology which can be used to reduce most of the environmental problem such as global warming due to change in climate. In high voltage applications multilevel inverter produces smooth output voltage. Harmonics are comparatively small. Multilevel inverter produce better performance even they are operated in medium voltage applications. Enhance the efficiency of thermo electric generator by using different types of converters such as full bridge H-bridge and modified H-bridge converter.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Reconfigurable Polyphase Filter Bank Receiver on Artix-7 FPGA
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Digital Signal Processing (DSP) is always an emerging research area in the field of electronics. The objective of the paper is to design a digital FIR filter with polyphase filter bank receiver structure which can be used for band limiting applications [1]. The sampling frequency for the design is chosen to be f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</sub>:30 KHz and the other frequencies Fpass<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>: 4 KHz, Fstop<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>: 6 KHz, Fstop<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>: 12 KHz, Fpass<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>: 14 KHz keeping the density factor: 20. The filter designed is a Direct-Form FIR filter with Order: 36 and designed using Equiripple method. The common operations that include addition multiplication and delays have been also implemented in this paper which uses 3-level parallel multiplier structure. The proposed system gives best measures in speed, power consumption and the hardware utilization. Direct Digital Synthesizer (DDS) core has been used to generate a message signal of 1-MHz frequency and 16-bit sample, which is used to test the proposed FIR filter. The Carrier signal of 10-MHz with 16-bit sample is also generated to get the modulated signal and the same modulated signal is passed through the FIR filter at the receiver for the noise removal and the reconstruction of the original signal [2]. The simulation part is carried out on Xilinx ISE and Modelsim 10.1 using VHDL language. And the synthesis part is implemented and verified on Artix-7 FPGA using chipscope pro tool.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Charge Density and Sheet Carrier Concentration in the 2DEG Area of AlGaN/AlN High Electron Mobility Transistors (HEMTs)
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: In this paper, the sheet carrier concentration and sheet charge density arising from the polarization effects in the AlGaNlAlN hetero-structure is evaluated. The two dimensional electron gas (2DEG) formed in the heterojunction region of the HEMT increases with increase in sheet carrier concentration. The concentration is calculated by varying the aluminium concentration at the range of 0<; x <; 1. Polarization effects are calculated in the 2DEG area of the High electron mobility transistor with respect to varying concentrations of Al in the GaN layer. High sheet carrier is attained at an Al concentration range of 0<; x <; 0.6. The mathematical analysis of sheet carrier concentration is done using MATLAB.

articleTitle: Identification of Stuck-at-faults of Full Adder using FPGA as a Testing Device
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Advanced CMOS devices are a critical issue due to the shrinking process of the size of the transistor. The number of transistors packed in an IC increases with the latest technology. Manufacturing defects in the chip happen due to the interconnection of wires. This leads to unexpected outputs. The process of testing confirms that the chip is fault free. This work discusses the number of test vectors needed to find the faults present in a full adder. It is achieved with the help of a field programmable gate array (FPGA). An adder circuit is realized in FPGA. Test vectors are also implemented in FPGA which is fed as inputs to the full adder. Thus generated outputs are tested with the expected outputs to identify the faulty position(s) in the full adder. Virtex -5 LX50T FPGA chip was used to realize the testing.

articleTitle: Energy Management using DE Algorithm with Two Grids
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: This paper evaluates parallel operation of RAMG and main grid energy management of load demand and power production using DE algorithm. Rural area Micro grids is synchronize with the utility grid, the equality between the five parameters such as current, voltage, amplitude, frequency and phase sequence are evaluate with the help of DE theorem. RAMG and the required demand is calculated regarding the sold out power or purchase power with the help of RAMG or by utility grid. Differential evolution algorithm is applied in the micro and main grid and to compensate the current, voltage and amplitude. In this parallel operation of utility grid and remote area or RAMG and compensate the current, voltage and frequency and vice versa. But in general phase sequence never changes.

articleTitle: Buck Converter Based Any Level Inverter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel multilevel inverter based on buck converter that can create any level at output. Multilevel inverters are preferred since it produces a smooth stepped output voltage waveform with output voltage having number of levels to reduce THD. But the trade-off in conventional multi-level inverters is in the control circuit complexity and more number of active& passive components for higher levels. A new type of buck converter based any level inverter (ALI) with varying duty ratio is proposed to mitigate the above problems to a great extent. The number of power electronic components remains same for any level of generation and thus the complexity of the circuit for higher level generation can be eliminated. Analysis of the proposed converter is carried out in this paper thoroughly and operation of the proposed any level inverter is verified by simulation using MATLAB/SIMULINK software.

articleTitle: Cloud Based Personalized Healthcare Using Deep Learning Framework
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Diabetes mellitus is a constant disease described by hyperglycaemia. It should cause a few complications. In keeping with the developing horribleness as of late, in 2040, the world's diabetic patients can achieve 642 million, which proposes that one in everything about 10 grown-ups inside what's to come is covered with polgenic illness. There is little inquiry that this minacious Figure needs pleasant consideration. With the quick improvement of profound adapting, profound learning has been connected to a few parts of restorative wellbeing. In such cases, diagnosing the patient with past medicinal records which is accessible in the open cloud condition will be helpful. Precisely distinguishing and positioning the likeness among patients upheld their verifiable records might be a key advance in redone demonstrating. With the available historical records, we will be able to predict the disease of a new patient by classifying the old records. In this paper, we build a cloud based Deep Convolutional Neural Network(DNN) model for predicting the patient's disease based on similarity measures. By maintaining the application on the cloud environment, the patient records can be accessed by different hospitals of different places and enhances quick recovery of records and patients from the disease. This paper differs from others in such a way that we process with text dataset rather than images. And also suggest natural remedies in case of presence of the disease.

articleTitle: Waveform Coding Techniques in Large Scale Antenna Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Scale Antenna System consist of several number of antennas and are used at the transmitter side as well as the receiver side to reduce interferences for obtaining low Bit Error Rate (BER) and high throughput of the signals during transmissions. In Large Scale Antenna Systems, an increased Cell Sites will reduces the interferences for obtaining high throughput of the signals. The Cell Sites consists of many number of antennas which transmits and receives the signals are placed at the fixed place and are used to communicate with the users or mobile phones. The better spectral containment per subcarrier can be achieved with the help of Filter Bank Multi Carrier (FBMC) technique. The cyclic prefix will not be used in FBMC, and so it increases the bandwidth efficiency. The aim of this system is to increase the throughput and to decrease the Bit Error Rate (BER) of the signals of FBMC technique in Large Scale Antenna System using different detection methods. The detection methods used in our proposed system are Maximal Ratio Combining, Zero Forcing.

articleTitle: Determination of Breast Cancer Using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Breast cancer is the second leading causes of disease in women. In practice effective ways to prevent breast cancer is still researched for a better solution, since the cause is not yet organised completely. Early detection is an effective way to diagnose and manage breast cancer can give better chance of full recovery. This work focuses on detection of breast cancer in digital mammograms. In this paper various preprocessing methods, segmentation process and classifier were discussed. In our work, Support Vector Machine is used to show accuracy on the breast cancer image. The accuracy test we had undergone using three SVM techniques.

articleTitle: Voltage Stability Constrained Optimal Power Flow Study Based on P-Index
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Recently voltage instability is one of the crucial issues in the heavily stressed and large interconnected power system. This paper proposes a study of Voltage Stability Constrained Optimal Power Flow (VSC-OPF) using a new bus voltage stability index named P-index. It has been concluded that VSC-OPF with the inclusion of P-index as an inequality constraint results in enhancement of static voltage stability and also reduction in active power losses of the system compared to conventional Optimal Power Flow. The proposed VSC-OPF is tested on IEEE 14 bus test system. OPF results are validated with that of MATPOWER for the IEEE 14 bus system.

Author Keywords: VSCOPF (Voltage Stability Constrained Optimal Power Flow)

articleTitle: A Bi-Directional Series Resonant AC Link Converter Topology for interfacing Battery storage with a PV system
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: The increasing concern on environmental impact has led electricity generation towards renewable energy (RE) resources like Solar, wind, ocean energy conversion, etc. Electric energy generated by using RE is not sufficient to mitigate the demand towards load and main grid side. Therefore, a storage system is needed to supply constant power to the load at any point in time. In this paper, the focused topic is to supply constant power to the utility side using a universal resonant inverter during an emergency. A 220W PV module is connected to the grid using the maximum power point tracking technique. This PV will send continuous power during day time to the ac load via a converter. A single phase bidirectional Partial Series resonating converter (DC-AC) concept has been proposed for the purpose of charging and discharging of the battery system. Link capacitor stores the charge whereas inductor has the purpose to facilitate zero-current turn-off for the switches. The proposed model and operation is verified by using MATLAB Simulink software.

articleTitle: Generalized Mathematical Framework and Alpha Domain for Understanding of Fractional Calculus
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: `alpha' domain is a tool for the more understanding of fractional calculus. This will solve 'open research problem' stated in fractional systems. Alpha domain is constructed using the mathematical concept of convolution and fractional diffintegration. In this work, convolution process in time domain treated as the convolution transform in the alias time `t'. Convolution transform has the varying 'kernel structure' with respect to time. “Change of kernel with respect to time”, is the concept that can solve many complicated research problems. At least, mathematical model of complicated system can be derived using present concept. The present 'theoretical work' is suitable for the system which has sharp decay/rise at beginning and very slow decay/rise at the end. Relationship between space (alpha) and time could be understood with the help of alpha domain and fractional calculus. Geometrical meaning of fractional Diffintegration can also be understood using alpha domain. Three kind of fractional order systems have been studied and its step response is computed as a part of applications.

Author Keywords: step response of Fractional order systems

articleTitle: Performance of Fiber with Elevated Refractive Index at Core Axis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: This paper deals with the performance of Multimode Step Index (MSI) fiber at the bit rate of 40Gbps. A $50 \mu \mathrm{m}$ MSI fiber is designed with the profile of inner core, outer core and the cladding. Instead of analyzing the dip in refractive index at core axis, this paper proposes an idea of slightly elevating the refractive index at core axis. This is simulated by Optifiber software at the wavelength of 1550nm. The dispersion and bend forbearance of designed MSI fiber is analyzed by varying the index difference between core and cladding. Elevated Refractive Index Profile (RIP) with cladding index n<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">clad</inf> of 1.40871 provides improved tolerance of macro bending losses at 1550nm and Elevated Refractive Index Profile (RIP) with cladding index n<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">clad</inf> of 1.{44871 provides reduced dispersion at 1550nm.The MSI fiber with these Elevated RIPs are applied at the optical communication link at bit rate of 40 Gbps and is simulated using Optisystem simulation software.

articleTitle: CPW Fed Yagi Uda Excitation of Substrate Integrated Waveguide Mode and its Application
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: An excitation innovation of TE30 mode in substrate Integrated wave guide (SIW) and its applications for planning to reduced Yagi-Uda radio wire application has been proposed. Coplanar wave guide (CPW) fed antenna design is embraced as the info and two openings of feds are additionally stretched out in the TE30 mode. Accordingly, TE30 mode is effectively energized and a Yagi-uda reception apparatus exhibit nourished. A widerbandwidth of data transmission shows 46% at 5.2 to 5.8GHz and its is accomplished with getting a most extreme gain of 5.5 dBi. Contrasted and the conventional SIW reception apparatus cluster dependent on TE10 mode, the higher mode excitation innovation rearranges the bolstering system as well as diminishes the trouble of handling.

articleTitle: Low cost, On-Demand and Intermittent Drug Delivery System through Syringe Infusion for Improving the Health of Critical Care Patients
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Drug delivery is a technology utilized to administer pharmaceuticals into the body to pull off a therapeutic effect in target species. Earlier methods such as oral drug delivery, drug delivery using injections may cause fluid delivery errors. In order to reduce the errors and to control the flow of medication levels into the blood and also to limit continuous monitoring of patient throughout the day, syringe pumps have been used by the physicians for the past decades. A syringe pump or syringe driver is a small infusion pump which is used to administrate very small amount of medications such as palliatives (painkillers), antiemetic (medication to suppress nausea and vomiting) and other drugs into the blood intravenously. They are mainly used to release IV medication at very low flow rates over a period of time. They can deliver the drugs at the necessary level with maximum exactitude. However, the repeated drug delivery into the patient within a specified infusion time is unfeasible. As some patient's who is under continuous monitoring in intensive care units and all other emergency care units needs timely medication at regular intervals. To overcome this problem our work is aimed at designing a syringe pump which helps in on-demand and intermittent drug delivery.

articleTitle: Ann Based Model With Pca For Fault Diagnosis In Ring Spinning Process
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: The most major problem experienced/faced by textile industry is the formation of bobbins from yarns to accomplish storage purpose. In this event/process, the twist staple fibers are spun into yarn and it needs rigorous and consistent monitoring. Yarn strength and its thickness relatively vary when there is an imbalance or uneven spinning. To rectify this debacle, an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) based model is proposed through this paper. The parameters such as spindle speed, top roller pressure, traveller mass, temperature, current and voltage are used as the input variables for training the ANN and PCA models. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is used to downsize the dimension of the input data. The proposed PCA with ANN model has improved performance and classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Radio Receiver : A Design For Receiving Jupiter Signal
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: In this paper we present the technical details of electromagnetic radio signal receiver that we have designed to observe the radio burst signals from the planet Jupiter. The novelty in the work comes from a custom designed electrically small loop antenna, simple RC filters, off the shelf amplifiers and a low cost Software Defined Radio (SDR) based data recorder. The paper describes design details of the receiver, implementation and test results.

articleTitle: AUTOSAR Based Dual Core Partitioning for Power Train Application of BMS
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: This project aims to partition the processing load into two cores of a dual core processor on AUTOSAR based systems by analyzing the coupling between different application software components(ASWs). BMS implemented on AUTOSAR based single core processor using in-house developed AUTOSAR stack development tool is the reference for this work. The major part of it is data profiling, in which we find out the coupling between application software components in terms of no of interfaces, memory and task, so that we can effectively partition ASWs to achieve good parallel processing and hence improve the throughput. AUTOSAR layered architecture allows the application development independent of underlying hardware. Migrating to a dual core platform is made more simpler by the in-house developed AUTOSAR stack development tool.

articleTitle: Comparison of Different Wavelet Packet Trees for Effective Speaker Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Automatic Speaker Recognition (ASR) aims at finding out the speaker's identity from their speech signal. Different from the traditional mel-bank filters that are used to obtain subbands, we transform the signals from the time domain into wavelet domain by Wavelet Packet Decomposition (WPD). Moreover, the WPD is designed such that the frequency scale is sub-partitioned equivalent to auditory scales that mimic the response of human cochlea. Cepstral coefficients are calculated for the resulting subbands. This is followed by classification by K nearest neighbor algorithm to get the speaker recognition rate (SRR). In this paper, three different WP decompositions (Optimal Wavelet Packet Tree, Equivalent Rectangular Bandwidth (ERB) scale based Signal Decomposition, and Bark scale based WP Decomposition) are compared and the results are tabulated. Experimental results show that ERB scale based Signal Decomposition gives better SRR than the other Wavelet Packet Trees, when FSDD database is tested.

articleTitle: Load Profile Generation for DR Program
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Demand Response is the widespread issue that the utility companies endure in supplying required electricity to its consumers. The utility companies implement comprehensive models to predict the raise in demand. Though peak demand is being predicted in advance or in a dynamic time, it`s the role of consumers of electricity to down the peak. The residential consumers are the major consumers of electricity. Therefore, the residential consumers are focused for the electric energy related issues like Demand Response. The consumption pattern differs from resident to resident based on number of factors like their location, demographic details, environmental factors etc. To investigate certain important factors, a mathematical model for generating the residential consumers load profile is proposed in this paper. It aims to categorize consumers based on dwelling type and mathematical model to generate resident load profile for each type. The dwelling type of the residents are the building types like bungalow, apartment, Villa, individuals and condominium. The model formula represents the resident`s appliances stock and its possible utilization for generating the load profile specific to each type. The load profiles are generated based on resident activity. For each activity, certain electric appliance is used by the resident, whose electricity consumption is linked to its corresponding timeslot of the day to generate load profile of the resident. The probability distribution function is used for appliance on/off status representation. This paper also designs a demand response technique which is explored by using the electricity generated value of utility and the overall consumption value of the residential consumers. These generated load profiles are tested by the designed demand control technique. The raise in demand is simulated and let the optimal consumers to participate and respond by shifting their appliances running mode to later time rather than on demand time. The result verifies the reduction in raised peak of demand in electricity and also uncompromised the energy utilization of every resident.

articleTitle: Comparative Study on Data Compression Techniques in Cache to Promote Performance
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Cache memory is a small, faster memory used to store recently accessed data or neighboring data item, so that the data need not be acquired from next level memories. The use of cache memory reduces the overall memory access time. As cache memory is related to memory speeding up process, the caching process should consume less time. To speed up caching process, there are many cache optimizations available. Some of the cache optimization process are reducing miss rate, reducing miss penalty, reducing the time to hit in the cache etc. Recent advancement paved way for compressing data in cache. Through data compression in cache more data resides in cache resulting in more hit ratio. There are many cache related compression and optimization techniques available. The paper deals with some recent techniques of compression.

articleTitle: Multi Objective Differential Evolution Algorithm for Optimal Building Energy Management System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Globally, the increase in usage of primary energy in buildings is major concern. Buildings are considered as the second largest energy consumers in the world which accounts for about 40%. Hence it is important to reduce the building primary energy consumption for overall energy consumption reduction. Building energy management system is one of the best solutions for energy consumption reduction. Its aim is to reduce the consumption of energy without compromising the consumers comfort. In this study, a Multi-Objective Differential Evolution (MODE) optimization is proposed to reduce the building energy consumption as well as increase the consumer comfort. The energy consumption and consumer comfort are taken as two objectives in this work. The result inferred that, the MODE has appeared to be favorable in reducing consumption of energy and improve the consumer effort.

articleTitle: Flow Regime Identification of Two Phase Flow based on Image Processing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Bubble column reactors are common in many industries such as biochemical, energy generation, process industry etc. The performance of the reactor is dependent on the flow regime inside the column. Identification of the flow regimes inside the reactor is significant and a challenging task. In the present paper, non-intrusive, real time approaches for regime identification are developed, based on the image processing technique and Symbolic Dynamic Filtering (SDF) in MATLAB. Flow images are captured using a Photron high speed (1000 fps) camera. The bubble detection algorithm results in the calculation of bubble diameters and the distribution of the bubble diameters for different flow rates, leading to regime identification. The algorithm includes the method of calculation of the optimum threshold luminescence value and converting the input image into binary using that optimum threshold value. From the binary image, boundaries are traced and the average bubble diameter is calculated. The deviation from one regime to another regime is detected by SDF algorithm. Flow measure (μ) is a parameter obtained from SDF, which indicates the deviation of a particular flow from the reference flow. The variation of flow measure is plotted against the air flow rate. It is found that change in the slope of this curve is significant during regime transition. This parameter can be used as a marker of flow regime identification.

articleTitle: Design of Low-cost Customized Laryngoscope
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Airway management has important role in emergency conditions. Laryngoscopy is a technique used for endotracheal intubation in which endotracheal tract of the subject is being viewed. Direct and video laryngoscopy is general techniques, whereas in former technique for optimal glottis visualization, physician needs a straight alignment of airway axes (oral-pharyngeal-laryngeal) which is impossible in all conditions. It may lead to adverse implications. Later video laryngoscopy, a trending technique comes with an excellent and magnified view of the larynx. Even though video laryngoscope provides excellent view of glottis, it cannot be used frequently. Because it exhibits difficult intubations and needs more time to intubate. To overcome the current obstacles, this work aims at designing of low-cost customized laryngoscope which is a combination of both direct and video laryngoscope. It supports to capture a real time high quality video of an endotracheal tract with the help of USB camera offers LED for good vision and brightness adjustment as well as direct visualization of larynx. It also limits intubation time and airway trauma.

articleTitle: Pattern Recognition-Recognition of Handwritten Document Using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Handwritten documents recognition is a challenging task in the field of pattern recognition. It has an array of applications wherein recognition of words, alphabets, digits and other characters are the mandate. This review article mainly focuses review on Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based handwritten documents recognition system. Basically, the handwritten recognition is divided into two different types: online and offline recognition. The difficulty of this system is dealing with huge variety of handwritten styles written by different writers. The system wants to recognize and identify such characters in effective manner. The scope of this review paper is to represent the merits and limitations of different techniques used in the development of recognition system. This paper definitely helps the researcher to get new idea to develop a new technique with good environment and architecture to propose more accuracy and less error rate. The major bottlenecks in this system are the issues of recognizing unconstrained handwritings like cursive, block, and tilt that cause huge variation in writing styles, the overlapping and the interconnections between characters. These systems are designed to assure high accuracy and reliability. This article summarizes different strategies in handwritten recognition system, which may help the researchers interested in this area to spot the research gap. The Future work of this paper is to implement a robust technique providing more accuracy and less error rate.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning Techniques to Classify Web Services
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: The architects and designers of some of the most recent web applications are resorting to the use of a variety of different languages and platforms. Each of these applications are required to communicate among one another to make a common unifying service. Communication may involve the sending and receiving information or the transformation and simplification of it. Each of these heterogeneous applications serves a different intent and are therefore taken to share a different architecture. Different languages and descriptions are so used to leverage the same. It therefore becomes difficult for these applications to communicate with and exchange information amongst one another. Web service technologies are independent of the design and architecture of the underlying applications. Thus, these technologies can tackle this issue by standardizing the way these applications communicate with one another. This paper proposes machine learning models that could be used to classify these web services viz., K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Naïve Bayes (Gaussian Naïve Bayes Classifier), Kernel Support Vector Machine Classifier (Kernel SVM), linear SVM, Decision Trees and Random Forests. The QWS (Quality Web Services) dataset has been used for classification and analysis.

Author Keywords: Kernel Support Vector Machine Classifier (Kernel SVM)
ve Bayes Classifier), Kernel Support Vector Machine Classifier (Kernel SVM), Linear SVM, Decision Trees, Random Forests

articleTitle: Smart Meter Data Analysis Issues: A Data Analytics Perspective
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: In recent years, the power sector has seen major developments in terms of infrastructure. Incorporating Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) is one of the significant move that has modernized the power industry to what is called Smart Grid. As a result of this, an enormous amount of data have been generated by the devices that are installed in the Smart Grid system especially the Smart Meters which is considered to be the backbone of the Smart Grid. Analyzing the Smart Meter data for the mutual benefit of both the energy suppliers and its consumers is a data science problem. This paper attempts to address the challenges and issues relevant to data acquisition from a real-time setup and different data analytics perspective of Smart Meter data namely descriptive analytics, predictive analytics and prescriptive analytics. The discussion is extended to some of the publicly available Smart Meter datasets including residential customers. The paper also dictates possible immediate requirements and future directions in this area.

articleTitle: Smart Toll Tax Automation and Monitoring System Using Android Application
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: In recent years, the amount of traffic in most of the roads are increased since the number of vehicles is getting increased day by day. There are some of the highway roads, where the people need to pay Toll Tax in order to use the same. Most of the toll collection centers are manually operated which is a time-consuming process and leads to heavy traffic, fuel wastage and other public issues. To automate this process, we propose a smart toll tax automation and monitoring system using RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) technology and mobile android application integration which enables the people to pay the toll tax automatically without any human intervention. The proposed work is implemented using RFID enabled smart cards which can be placed in the vehicle and it is integrated with an android application which will initiate the payment process. The SMS facility is also integrated in order to notify the details of tax deduction to the respective consumers. The proposed system provides faster response when compared to other traditional approaches.

articleTitle: Maximum Energy Extraction of a Wind Farm Using Pitch Angle Control
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: The main aim of this paper is to focus on the energy management of electric energy generated by a wind farm. The objective of this paper is to satisfy or compensate the energy constraints fixed by the loads. For this purpose, a suitable control strategy must be carried out to produce the mandatory amount of power needed to satisfy the demand. The control strategy of the wind farm is pitch control to protect the wind turbines against mechanical stress or failure at the event of wind gust. Pitch angle control is used to extract maximum energy from a wind farm, so that sustainable energy management is achieved.

articleTitle: ANFIS based QoS-aware Routing Protocol for Video Streaming in MANETS
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Quality of Service (QoS) aware routing in Mobile Adhoc Networks (MANETs) remains a major challenging task in networking community. Most of the existing works falter due to mobile nature of node, resulting in decrease of bandwidth, delay and number of hops. This paper proposes an ANFIS based QoS(ANFIS-QoS) approach to creating new optimal routes in according with video stream requirements. The introduction of hyperlink & estimation of bandwidth in route availability mechanisms and an adaptive system that could afford remarks to supply node about the recent community country, to allow the software to correct adjustment of the transmission fee based on the ANFIS model. Within the identical way, we suggest a course restoration technique into the protocol named AODV will offer a mechanism on detecting the disaster link in a route and re-set up the connections taking into consideration the situations of QoS that have been hooked up at some point of the preceding course discovery section. The simulation consequences of the proposed ANFIS-QoS screen improvement in performance on phrases of packet put off, range of linkage failures and connection setup latency. In consideration of video broadcast, the acquired effects show that the collective usages of ANFIS-QoSand the video coding delivers the scalable and efficient stage for assisting charge-adaptive video streaming.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Quantification of Epicardial Fat from Non-Contrast CT
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Epicardial Adipose Tissue is a visceral fat presently on the walls of the heart and pericardium.it has a direct correlation with coronary disease.it likewise possibly causes nearby inflammation and likely has direct effects on coronary atherosclerosis. This metabolically recognized by pro-inflammatory mediator. hence this fat must be quantified and segmented to diagonized the heart related disease..EAT can be manually measured but it is difficult task.it requires experienced technical members it is a time consuming process.so we propose a novel segmentation algorithm using k means clustering and further propose convolution neural network for fine segmentation of the image. We advise a fast and fully mechanized algorithm for Epicardial Adipsoe Tissue volume calculation from non-contrast calcium scoring Computed Tomography datasets using a machine learning Tecniques it is nothing but machine learnig techniques. Our proposed approach involves in preprocessing of CT images and Segment the image using K mean clustering algorithm. Then we fine tune the segmented image using CNN framework.CNN is an unsupervised calculation and machine learning method is utilized for how to adapt such great highlights automatically. The purpose behind we assessed the epicardial fat volume is the epicardial layer is closer to the heart. If may the layer thickness get expanded than specific range the patient may influenced by coronary illness. At long last it causes passing. We evaluated the performance of this process in terms of epicardial fat volume, Correlation Coeffecient, Mean Squared error, processing time.

articleTitle: Fog Computing for Smart Grid Development and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: The Smart Grid (SG) is the emerging energy systems that are enticed by smart devices and entities to support its control and monitoring. The SGs” core challenge is how to efficiently utilize different types of smart front-end devices, such as smart meters and power assets, and process the huge volume of data from these devices. Cloud Computing (CC) provides flexible services and resources to comply with SG application”s computational requirements. Although the CC model is considered efficient for SG, the Quality of Experience (QoE) requirements, such as energy consumption, latency, bandwidth and network cost, for SG services are not guaranteed. Fog Computing (FC) reaches the edge of a network Computing providing low latency, latency - sensitive analytics and location awareness to satisfy the critical SG application”s mission requirements. The aim of this work is to comprehend FC applicability to interplay with the cloud support, thus enabling to develop a new range of latency-free utilities in real time. In this paper, we provide an in-depth survey on various fog computing approaches for smart grid architecture. Also, the current state of research on the development of smart grids is presented in this survey.

articleTitle: Annotation and Retrieval of Retinal Images using Support Vector Machine with Active Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: In the medical field, many images are acquired using different modalities like X-ray, Computed Tomography and Magnetic Resonance Imaging. Organizing these images and retrieving them is a critical task. In this paper, a novel retinal image retrieval and automatic annotation of ten different retinal diseases is presented and is comprised of three steps namely, feature extraction, automatic annotation and retrieval of similar images. In feature extraction, visual features like texture, color and shape were derived from the images and stored in a database. The retinal images are affected by various diseases and have to be identified easily and quickly for better treatment. For automatic annotation, we have considered ten different retinal diseases and annotated the retinal image with its corresponding disease using Support Vector Machine (SVM) with Active Learning (AL) and discriminative based automatic image annotation. In retrieval of images, Bray Curtis distance measure was used to retrieve the similar images by comparing the feature values of images stored in the database. Our proposed system has achieved a precision of 82% and specificity of 96.3%.

articleTitle: F-DEMATEL Method to Evaluate Criteria for Affecting Productivity in HP Valve Manufacturing Industries
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: High pressure valves are one of the key elements in the boiler design and manufacturing. They are the main reason for the high safety and efficiency of the boiler. The high-pressure valves manufacturer finds it very difficult in finding the right criteria in manufacturing and production of the high-pressure valves. Even if the manufacturers find the criteria, they find it difficult to rank the criteria and prioritize the criteria for the high effective production of the valves. This study mainly focuses on increasing the productivity of the high-pressure valve manufacturing industry in India. This requires in-depth analysis of the criteria and ranks them according to their influence on the other criteria. Here, we have selected twelve important criteria that affect the productivity of the manufacturing of HP valves. These criteria are selected based on the literature available in manufacturing of the high-pressure valves. These criteria are segregated and ranked according to the nature and influence they tend to project on other criteria. Here we have applied Fuzzy decision-making trial and evaluation laboratory (FDEMATEL). This methodology focuses on relating each criterion on other criteria depending on the influencing valve they possess. This study helps the high-pressure valve manufacturing industry in understanding the criteria that are affecting the productivity. There by also helps in improving the efficiency of the productivity of manufacturing industry.

articleTitle: Clustering of Web Documents with Structure of Webpages based on the HTML Document Object Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Web mining is an emerging Data Mining arenathat usesvarious techniques to explore hidden patterns available within the WWW. Clustering has significant applications in Web mining, particularly in grouping Webpages based on their various properties. Literature suggests that clustering applied over Webpages is generally based on the contents of the availableWebpages, thereby focusing on text mining techniques only. But since unlike normal text documents Webpages are structured documents, there is a scope of exploring whether the structural properties of Webpages have any impact on their clustering. This paper aims to apply clustering on Web Documents based on DOM structure of Webpages, where the HTML-DOM structure of each Webpage has been represented as a string of characters, and then applying K-means clustering on the string representation. The same algorithm has been applied with four different distance measures on four different datasets. The clustering output in each case has been evaluated and the results have been compared.

articleTitle: Fingerprint Template Security using Angle-Based Transformation Functions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: In today's materialistic world security holds an indispensable place. There is a need for security in almost every sector of the society. To overcome the threat, a security system has been proposed using Fingerprint Authentication. Storing the fingerprint template as it is in the database, results in the compromise of one's identity if the database is stolen or hacked. Henceforth, the template has to be made secure by applying a transformation that makes the attacker's possibility of revoking back to the original Fingerprint Template infeasible. This approach uses three different transformations to secure the template. Three different transformation functions namely Conformal, Isogonal and Indirectly Conformal mapping functions are selected and are applied to the original fingerprint template and the effectiveness of each transformation is comparatively analyzed. The main objective of this system is to design and implement a fingerprint biometric security system to transform the original template that is free from all the vulnerabilities by reducing the False Acceptance Rate and improving the False Rejection Rate. The system using conformal mapping has an Equal Error Rate (EER) of 2.8%, the system using isogonal mapping has an EER of 3% and finally the system using indirectly conformal mapping has an EER of 2.7%.

articleTitle: Eminent identification and classification of Diabetic Retinopathy in clinical fundus images using Probabilistic Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy occurs due to increased risk at the eye via swelling and occurrence of abnormalities in blood vessels. In earlier several methods have been implemented to detect the diabetic retinopathy, but there is a lack of efficiency over the traditional methods that utilize unsupervised algorithms. Recently, deep learning plays a significant role in several technological applications such as Image recognition and semantic analysis that utilizes for portraying the DR. In our proposed methodology, an innovative framework has been implemented to overcome the issues of traditional methodology. Initially, an input image is acquired from the dataset. Then the preprocessing is performed where the image resizing and the double conversion is carried out and next to this image segmentation is the process where the morphological and thresholding-based operations are performed. The GLCM - an effective feature is chosen for extracting the features with the co-occurrence matrix. After extracting the features, the classification process is performed using Probabilistic Neural Network (PNN) which provides an effective classifier output. It is concluded that this novel vessel segmentation framework acquired better accuracy, sensitivity, F measures, specificity and precision from this experiment.

articleTitle: Mutual Information Based Time Delay Estimation of Ultra High Frequency Signals Radiated from Partial Discharge Sources
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: The Partial Discharge (PD) Source localization process is needed to assess the insulation condition more efficiently. As the complete breakdown of insulators would lead to power supply interruption and would cause a degraded power quality, the PD source localization process is much helpful to get rid of detrimental breakdown occurrence as the handling personnel can be warned about a probable breakdown source at a very premature state. Amongst many techniques, Time Delay of Arrival (TDOA) technique is a simple yet effective process to proceed for the PD source localization problem. Time delay estimation is an essential primary step to proceed for the localization process of a PD source using the TDOA technique. Here, Ultra High Frequency (UHF) wave emitted from the PD source is used for the Time Delay Estimation (TDE) as well as the localization process. The UHF signal is used here for its better accuracy and stability. Here, two sensors are made using microstrip patch antenna. Different techniques to estimate the TDOA of the signals in two different sensors is studied and their advantages and limitations are analyzed. In this paper, an approach to estimate the TDOA of signals in two different sensors using the Mutual Information (MI) based algorithm has been introduced which follows statistical approach. Mutual Information is the statistical interrelation between two continuous or discrete random variables. Here the data corresponding to captured signals are taken as continuous random variables and the time delay of arrival between two signals is estimated by computing the mutual information between two random variables. The Time delay is estimated in case of simulation generated theoretical partial discharge wave, after that the algorithm has been applied to experimentally captured data with the hardware set up, done in the High Voltage laboratory.

articleTitle: A Simple Traffic Management Approach Using Multipath TCP (MPTCP) in Software Defined Data Center (SDDC)
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Traffic management in Data Center has become a most important factor to attain energy efficiency and to achieve reliable communication. Software Defined Data Center handles end-to-end packet transmission with inbuilt traffic management ability by the controllers. But still arrival of enormous amount of data from various sources makes the network congested leading to increase in latency and poor link utilization. To overcome such kind of issues, instead of single TCP flow, Multipath TCP came in to existence as the data center network architecture completely depends on different number of flows and different paths needed by routing process. Effective utilization of bandwidth for all available links is possible through Multipath TCP. This improves the throughput and reliability in network performance. Many existing research works deal with the implementation of Multipath TCP in Software Defined Network enabled Data Center. With a deep study of various existing MPTCP mechanisms, hereby, we propose a traffic management approach using Multipath TCP for Software Defined Data Center. We implemented this proposed system in both centralized and Open Day light controller setup over Jellyfish topology in Mininet Virtual Simulator. The results clearly shows that the physically distributed and logically centralized Open Day light setup gives more utilization of links and less percentage of congested links once the network scales when compared to the centralized approach.
